contentList.content: A pair of spiked steel knuckles. Your main-hand attacks with it still count as unarmed attacks; the spikes tear flesh on impact.
Knuckles wrought from cold. Against a soaked target, the chill sinks straight into the bone.
No edge at all, only sheer weight. They say it once turned a full suit of plate - and the man inside - into iron filings.
Your main-hand attacks with this weapon count as unarmed attacks.
Unarmed attacks deal an extra 1d4 Piercing damage and have a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding for 2 turns.
Unarmed attacks deal an extra 1d6 Cold damage, or 2d6 against Wet targets.
Unarmed attacks deal an extra 2d10 Bludgeoning damage and apply Sundered for 3 turns.
A melee attack made with knuckle dusters - resolved as an unarmed attack.
Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage. Two stacks are enough to make even a resistant target fragile.
